name: Circuit Issues KiCad OutputJob Plugin
description: Generate common post-design outputs (Gerbers, BOM, STEP, renders, iBOM, JLCPCB) from one dialog
description_full: An Action Plugin for KiCad 9/10 that consolidates common post-design export tasks into a single dialog. Supports schematic PDF, STEP 3D model, Gerbers, drill files, pick-and-place CSV, BOM CSV, 3D render PNGs, and optional integration with the JLC Plugin for KiCad and InteractiveHtmlBom. Settings are stored per-project in a local .kicad_plugin_config.json file.
